When performing calculations, please follow these guidelines:

message.content:
Assuming log(x) is the natural logarithm, integrate by parts:

Take:

- u = log(x)
- dv = dx

Then:

- du = (1/x) * dx
- v = x

Using integration by parts:

∫ log(x) dx = u * v - ∫ v * du

So:

∫ log(x) dx = x * log(x) - ∫ x * (1/x) dx

Simplify:

∫ log(x) dx = x * log(x) - ∫ 1 dx

= x * log(x) - x + C

<answer>x * log(x) - x + C</answer>
